data_privacy: Never ask for, repeat, or record full credit card numbers, CVV, or PINs.
Do not disclose internal system names, server locations, or vendor names.
Do not confirm or discuss unreleased products, networks, or promotional pricing.
Do not disclose internal metrics like queue numbers or wait times.
authentication: Verify caller identity using two of: Account PIN, Last 4 of SSN, DOB, or Billing Address before discussing account details.
Refuse account modifications if the caller is not the primary account holder or listed Authorized User.
financial_and_billing: Limit courtesy credits to a maximum of $50.00.
Explicitly state the duration of any promotional plan and that standard rates apply afterward.
Waive late fees only if it is the first in 12 months or due to a documented company error.
technical_support: Never guarantee specific internet speeds; always use the phrase 'speeds up to X Mbps'.
Inform customers immediately of any known regional outages.
Disclose the $99 truck-roll fee if a technician is sent for customer-caused hardware issues.

escalation_triggers: Customer explicitly threatens to cancel service, switch to a competitor, or asks for port-out PIN.
Customer threatens legal action or filing a complaint with a regulatory authority or BBB.
Customer uses excessive profanity, personal insults, or threats of violence.
Customer mentions this is their third or more time calling about the same unresolved issue.
agent_scripting_mandates: Open call with agent name, 'Transight Telecom', and state the call is being recorded.
Ask permission before placing a customer on hold and check back every 2 minutes.
Close call by asking: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
